clips.title: The story
paras: In central Ashenvale, south of Splintertree Post, Dor'Danil Barrow Den lies under Forsaken shadow. Druids once slept here while their spirits roamed the Emerald Dream, but now the sanctuary is filled with horror.

Night elven druids have slept for centuries in barrow dens across Kalimdor, their bodies sheltered underground as their spirits traveled the Emerald Dream. When the Horde pushed into Ashenvale, Dor'Danil lay deep behind enemy lines. The orcs mostly left the sleeping elves alone, but the newly allied Forsaken saw an opportunity. Their agents entered the depths and began experiments to sever the druids from their spirits. The ordeal fractured the dreamers' minds and drove them mad. Now sinister Forsaken assassins prowl the dark hollows, alongside the tormented spirits of druids who cannot return to their bodies.
